weather_report:
Late morning in Subiaco arrives under a patchwork sky, the sun slipping in and out of broken cloud that softens the light and cools the edges of the day. It feels open and unhurried, the sort of brightness that comes in measured sips rather than a glare, with glimpses of blue promising a clearer turn.

Through the day, those clouds look set to thin into scattered tufts, letting warmer sunshine reach the streets and gardens; when the sun finds those gaps, the UV will wake up, so a hat, sunglasses, and a touch of sunscreen pair well with light, breathable layers. It’s a pleasant day for small errands done on foot, a quiet bench and a paperback, or hanging a wash to dry between spells of sun. If work calls, an early-afternoon walk for a sandwich will do nicely, the light turning kinder but still bright enough to keep the world vivid without harshness.
